name: @projexlight/sdk-payment
summary: Payment processing for ProjexCloud: tokenized payment-method attach (cards / ACH / wallets) via Stripe (default) with adapter slots for Adyen, Braintree, and on-prem PSPs. Charge + refund + multi-party distribution (escrow/marketplace flows). PCI scope minimized — PANs never touch our DB; only provider tokens + last-4 are persisted.

endpoints.description: Attach a tokenized payment method to a tenant. Body carries a provider token (e.g. Stripe pi_*); we never see the PAN.
Charge an attached payment method. Idempotent on (tenant_id, idempotency_key). Returns the charge_id and captured amount.
Issue a full or partial refund against a captured charge.
Multi-party distribution against a captured charge (marketplace / escrow / reseller commission). Splits routed to provider party-ids.

events.name: payment.method.attached.v1
events.description: New payment method tokenized + saved against a tenant. Carries provider + last4 + brand.

events.name: payment.succeeded.v1
events.description: Charge captured successfully. Consumed by sdk-billing to advance invoice dunning state machine.

events.name: payment.failed.v1
events.description: Charge declined or errored. Carries the provider-level decline_code for retry decisions.

events.name: payment.refunded.v1
events.description: Refund issued. Full vs partial flagged in payload.

events.name: payment.distributed.v1
events.description: Multi-party split distributed. Carries the per-party splits + provider transfer IDs.

models.description: Tokenized payment-method handle. Stores provider_id + token + last4 + brand + status. NEVER PAN.
Captured charge against a payment_method. Idempotency-key indexed for replay safety.
Per-charge refund log. Refunded_amount may be partial.
Per-charge multi-party split: party_id, amount, transfer_id, status.

hooks.name: registerStripeAdapter
hooks.description: Default provider adapter; wired at gateway startup if STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is set. Other providers slot in via the same registerPaymentProvider() shape.

scenarios.title: Attach a credit card to a tenant
scenarios.when_to_use: Self-serve checkout flow. Customer enters card details in the provider's tokenized form (Stripe Elements / equivalent); the resulting token is what we accept.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Payment_method row created; PAN never persisted. Emits payment.method.attached.v1. Tenant-admin Billing page shows the masked card.

scenarios.title: Charge a tenant's saved card for a finalized invoice
scenarios.when_to_use: End-of-period billing close. Driven by a worker that picks up billing.invoice.finalized.v1 and charges the saved method.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Returns { charge_id, status }. Emits payment.succeeded.v1 or payment.failed.v1. sdk-billing's dunning workflow consumes either to advance/halt the invoice state machine.

scenarios.title: Partial refund after customer dispute
scenarios.when_to_use: Support resolves a dispute; refund a subset of a previously captured charge.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Refund row written; provider receives the refund instruction. Emits payment.refunded.v1. Operator-visible in the per-tenant ledger.

scenarios.title: Split a charge across multiple party recipients (marketplace flow)
scenarios.when_to_use: Reseller commissions, escrow releases, or marketplace seller payouts where one customer charge fans out to many recipients.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Per-split distribution row created; provider issues the transfers. Emits payment.distributed.v1 with the transfer_id per party. Reconciles 1:1 against payment.succeeded.v1.

scenarios.title: Auto-detach payment methods on tenant offboard
scenarios.when_to_use: Reactive worker — consumes tenant.offboarded.v1, deletes attached methods at the provider, marks rows revoked.
scenarios.expected_outcome: All payment_method rows for the tenant flip to revoked; provider tokens deleted upstream. Idempotent — safe to replay.

compliance_posture.notes: PCI scope is SAQ-A (lowest tier) because we never touch PANs — provider iframes handle the card capture and we only ever hold tokens. STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET verifies inbound provider notifications. PSD2 Strong Customer Authentication handled by provider — we surface SCA challenges via the redirect_url returned from charge().

pricing_skus.unit_description: per attached method (free; provider per-attach fee passthrough)
per charge (provider passthrough + ProjexCloud platform fee)
per refund issued (no platform fee on refunds)
